zh.title: 阿聯酋航空本冬季取消三條不停站A380航線
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空本冬季取消三條不停站A380航線，相關地點將不見其雙層客機
body: Simple Flying報導，阿聯酋航空本冬季取消三條不停站A380航線。標題說明取消的航線數量、機型與適用季節；摘要則補充，與去年冬季相比，這些地點本季不會看到該航空公司的雙層客機。
摘要提到相關地點，但沒有列出地點名稱。報導目前提供的訊息，呈現的是三條不停站A380航線在本冬季取消，以及這些地點與去年冬季的差異；摘要並未說明各航線的個別安排。

en.title: Emirates cancels three nonstop A380 routes this winter
en.summary: Emirates cancels three nonstop A380 routes this winter; affected places will not see its double-deckers.
body: Simple Flying reports that Emirates is cancelling three nonstop A380 routes this winter. Its headline specifies the number of routes and the aircraft model, and places the cancellations in the winter season. The accompanying summary compares this winter with last winter, saying that none of the places concerned will see the carrier's double-deckers this season.

The summary refers to the affected places but does not name them. The information provided describes the cancellations and the seasonal comparison, without specifying the individual route arrangements. It therefore does not identify which places are affected, beyond saying that none of the places concerned will see the carrier's double-deck aircraft this winter.

zh.title: 歐洲研議擴大關鍵基礎設施業者反制無人機權限
zh.summary: 歐洲多國研議擴大業者反制權限；法國已通過相關法律
body: 歐洲多國正考慮賦予關鍵基礎設施營運者更大權限，以因應無人機威脅，當中包括傳統上由國家機關執行的措施。各國仍須處理由誰有權應對無人機，以及無人機遭擊落後若造成人員受傷或財物損害，責任應如何歸屬等法律問題。
法國已於8月通過法律，允許關鍵基礎設施營運者及承包商，在指定設施附近偵測、幹擾並擊落無人機。法國也希望在2027年前，為攸關國家安全的敏感設施更新名單並配置反無人機系統，相關細節尚未公開。

en.title: European governments weigh expanded drone powers for infrastructure operators
en.summary: European countries weigh broader operator powers against drones; France passed a law permitting counter-drone action near designated sites.
body: Several European countries are considering giving critical-infrastructure operators and contractors broader powers to counter drones, including measures traditionally reserved for state authorities. Governments still need to resolve who may respond to a drone threat and what liability could follow if a downed drone causes injury or property damage.

In August, France passed a law allowing infrastructure operators and contractors to detect, jam and shoot down drones near designated facilities. France also wants an updated list of sensitive sites vital to national security to be equipped with counter-drone systems by 2027. Details have not been made public.

zh.title: Saudia與Riyadh Air改道經Al Qassim Airport接送利雅德旅客
zh.summary: Saudia與Riyadh Air改經Al Qassim Airport接送利雅德旅客，續程改搭巴士
body: Saudia與Riyadh Air正將前往利雅德的旅客改由Al Qassim Airport接運，後續公路行程超過四小時。King Khalid International Airport已於10月18日重新開放，但仍受營運限制。

Riyadh Air安排於10月22日（週四）開設從London Heathrow（LHR）、Madrid及Bangkok飛往Al Qassim Airport的特別航班，接載受航班中斷影響的旅客。抵達後，旅客可搭乘免費巴士前往利雅德，接駁已包含在機票內，無須另行預約；服務仍可能因營運調整而變動。NOTAM A3650/26要求航空器營運人在起降前取得沙烏地阿拉伯 General Authority of Civil Aviation 的許可。

en.title: Saudia and Riyadh Air route Riyadh passengers through Al Qassim Airport
en.summary: Saudia and Riyadh Air route Riyadh passengers through Al Qassim Airport, with onward bus transfers.
body: Saudia and Riyadh Air are routing passengers travelling to Riyadh through Al Qassim Airport, with onward road journeys taking more than four hours. King Khalid International Airport reopened on 18 October but remains subject to operational restrictions.

Riyadh Air has arranged special flights from London Heathrow (LHR), Madrid and Bangkok to Al Qassim on Thursday, 22 October, for passengers affected by the disruption. Arriving passengers will continue to Riyadh by complimentary bus; the transfer is included in the flight ticket and requires no separate reservation. The services remain subject to operational changes. NOTAM A3650/26 requires aircraft operators to obtain prior permission from Saudi Arabia’s General Authority of Civil Aviation before landing or departing.
